subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on December 15, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XYZ123 Departure: 10:00 AM Arrival: 2:00 PM Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
